script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Workplace
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. TECH COMPANY - DAY

The bustling office of a successful tech company. EMPLOYEES move about in a constant hum of activity.

INT. TECH COMPANY - RECEPTION AREA - DAY

ANNA (early 30s, dressed professionally) enters, a determined look on her face. She approaches the reception desk, where JESS (late 20s, bubbly and cheerful) sits.

JESS
(cheerfully)
Hi Anna! Welcome back!

ANNA
(nods)
Hi, Jess. Thanks for holding down the fort while I was away.

INT. TECH COMPANY - ANNA'S OFFICE - DAY

Anna sits at her desk, surrounded by computers and papers. She looks overwhelmed as she sorts through her emails. A knock on the door startles her.

ANNA
(looking up)
Come in.

MAYA (mid 30s, calm and collected) enters, carrying a tray of coffee and pastries.

MAYA
(smiling)
Thought you could use some fuel to get through the day.

Anna looks up, surprised and touched.

ANNA
(gratefully)
Thank you, Maya. This is really nice of you.

MAYA
(shrugs)
Just paying it forward. You helped me out when I was new here.

They share a smile and sit down to chat.

INT. TECH COMPANY - MEETING ROOM - DAY

Anna, Maya, and several other coworkers gather for a team meeting. The discussion is lively and productive. Anna notices that Maya is often the glue that holds the team together.

INT. TECH COMPANY - BREAK ROOM - LATER

Anna and Maya sit on a couch, talking over lunch.

ANNA
(smiling)
I've noticed how you always seem to keep things running smoothly around here.

MAYA
(laughs)
Just doing my part. But I couldn't do it without all of you.

INT. TECH COMPANY - ANNA'S OFFICE - NIGHT

Anna is still at her desk, working late. Maya enters, carrying take-out containers.

MAYA
(placing containers on the desk)
I figured you'd be here, so I brought you dinner.

Anna looks up, surprised and touched. They share a meal and continue to talk.

INT. TECH COMPANY - DAY

The office is now quiet, most employees have gone home. Anna and Maya are the last to leave.

ANNA
(looking at Maya)
I'm glad I have you here as a friend and a coworker.

MAYA
(smiling)
Feeling the same way, Anna.

They walk out together, their friendship stronger than ever.

FADE OUT.

THE END
